_meta.arm_note: The wrist cannot twist. The bake/IK must put the hand roll into the forearm: rotate L_forearm.001 by (1-split)*forearm_roll_deg and L_forearm by split*forearm_roll_deg about their local +Y (render.py applies this; 'auto' solves it so wrist twist = 0). pole_offset (m, rig space) is added to the reload bake's elbow pole for that phase.
_meta.description: Removal hold-and-release key (magazine seated, theta 0): palm high on the near face, index hooked under the receiver on the front edge, middle/ring/pinky wrapped over the front edge onto the far face, thumb reaching behind the magazine with its distal pad on the rear face of the paddle tab (pad faces +X), pinching the paddle against the finger wrap across the magazine depth.
_meta.press_beat: Author 3-4 frames before this key with the same hand_in_mag and the thumb 6-8 deg less MCP/IP flexion (pad ~2 mm behind the paddle); this key is the pressed state. Hold it while the magazine rocks to theta about -0.15 (hand rolls with the magazine: hand_in_mag is magazine-relative), then release the thumb and pull down/back-left.
_meta.rock_pivot_warning: pose_and_render rocks theta about LUG=(0.066,0,0.056), but the magazine top front edge is at x ~0.008; the real front lug pivot should be near (0.008,0,0.058). Check the bake's pivot before relying on theta.
_meta.elbow: Uses pole_offset (0, 0.05, -0.15) for this phase (elbow drop, like insert). Hand re-pitched ~10 deg (fit with a wrist term) so the wrist is less extended; the pole alone cannot reduce wrist extension because the shoulder and elbow angle are fixed (elbow only swings on a circle).
_meta.thumb_fix: Thumb pad core presses the rear face of the exposed paddle tab low (contact centroid z ~0.000, tab spans z -0.002..0.011) with the distal pad facing +X (bone pad dir 0.923, 0.106, -0.370); the tip stays ~3 mm below the trigger-guard ears and the nail clears the guard front by >= 1.78 mm. The paddle-to-guard gap at that height (~13 mm) is about one gloved thumb thickness, so a 2 mm+ nail clearance cannot be combined with pad contact.
_meta.fix2: Thumb re-coupled and re-split (fix2/): CMC extension -20 now pairs with cmc_rot 10 (was 44.9, pronation ceiling); MCP 20 / IP 30.8 (was 0.3 / 63.4, IP-only hook). Pad-core contact on the paddle tab (mean 23 deg from the pad, closest 0.17 mm, no penetration), tip kept below the trigger-guard ears (distal-thumb z max 0.0082 vs ear underside 0.0113, no 'other' contacts), nail side >= 1.78 mm from the guard front. Finger MCP cascade now index 8 < middle 18.5 ~ ring 18.1 ~ pinky 17.5 (was 8.1/42.5/50.9/13.3); ring/pinky mcp_abduct -5.8/+4.6 (was -10/-9.5). Fitted with fix2/fit4.py (cascade, CMC-coupling cmc_rot <= cmc_flex + 30, pad-core and tip-ceiling terms), config fix2/cfg_zw4.json.
